items.window_text: A study by a Japanese private clinic showed that COVID-19 vaccines do not affect male fertility. The fertility clinic analyzed 11 men who have not been infected with the novel coronavirus. They had all received the Pfizer shot. The study found no significant decrease in any of the sperm-quality parameters, including count, concentration and motility. The clinic is considering holding a joint research with Miami University to study the long-term sign effect on a larger number of people and the potential effect from booster shots.
